verdict.rationale: First-party docs state Khoj can be self-hosted on consumer hardware, installed via Docker or Pip, and configured through an admin panel, authentication options, a telemetry opt-out and customizable host/models. It also runs fully local chat via Ollama/LiteLLM. Community users confirm running it locally, though one hit a Docker build error and another saw heavy resource use on a laptop. Missing for 10: independent confirmation that the current Docker install builds cleanly, plus evidence of acceptable performance on modest consumer hardware.
